descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Perfect Parking XR brings miniature driving challenges into mixed reality. A detailed city appears on your table, while your VR controllers become the steering wheel. Navigate tight corners, avoid obstacles, and park with precision.

Whether you're looking for a quick challenge or a relaxing experience, Perfect Parking XR is easy to pick up and satisfying to master. Every level is designed around precision driving, rewarding careful movement, planning, and control.

Built specifically for mixed reality, the game transforms your surroundings into a miniature parking playground where every turn matters. Simple controls, clear visuals, and instant restarts make it easy to jump in for a few minutes or keep playing through challenge after challenge.

Features:
• Mixed reality miniature city environments
• Intuitive controller based driving
• Precision parking challenges
• Multiple unique level layouts
• Clean visuals and easy readability
• Fast restarts and smooth gameplay flow
• Perfect for both short sessions and extended play

Perfect Parking XR saves your current level locally and does not collect personal data.
